purpose: Native compositor and GPU-service CPU scheduling attribution; no measured GPU execution and never release acceptance

streamingIndex.boundsPolicy: Metadata, marks, track admission and category/phase/root-key storage fail before exceeding declared bounds. All auxiliary track maps use the admitted primary registry. A guard failure is distinct from browser trace data loss and permanently disables completeness.
streamingIndex.cancellationPolicy: Deadline, bounded-cleanup expiry, unexpected browser tracing transport closure and outer trace failure abort the shared scope and destroy active filesystem streams, including parser hash-only draining. Per-record synchronous work is bounded and checked afterward, not preempted.

parserSource.fork: trace-parser.mjs adds only root-key count/size guards and a provenance comment; it is not byte-identical to the source parser.

streamingIndex.capacityNote: Only the JSON file cap increases to 1 GiB. The recording buffer remains 512 MiB. The complete trace size and native two-pass cost remain unknown; no phase renews the 120-second finalization deadline and every late, capped, malformed or incomplete result remains partial.

trace.scopeChange: Browser-root Tracing has no page target PID filter. This explicitly broadens the former trusted page trace scope; the original renderer is still identified by its unchanged trusted W marks, and actual named cross-process category/flow coverage remains required.
trace.enumerationPolicy: Retain a valid string-array enumeration as advisory; request the unchanged seven categories once, then require actual trusted-W-window category and named track/flow evidence. Malformed enumeration and protocol/start errors fail.

finalizationBudget.allowanceNote: The 120-second limit is a finite post-stop collection allowance supported by the observed 60-second exhaustion. It retains one absolute stop-issuance deadline for acknowledgement, completion, drain, indexing and persistence; no phase renews it. Complete trace size and collection cost remain unproved. Original capture/input/performance gates and all other observer bounds are unchanged; any late or incomplete result remains partial.

semanticReference.note: The reference enumerated all seven proposed categories. Its CPU trace did not request cc, viz, gpu, toplevel or toplevel.flow; enumeration is not raw-event coverage.

volumeSizingAllowance.basis: Observed shared-category volume supersedes the initial 128 MiB sizing assumption.
volumeSizingAllowance.note: The peer has a different application build and category set. Its exact raw hash/bytes and the estimated reserialized shared-category union are capacity evidence, not a performance comparison or exact forecast. Complete volume for the four new categories remains unmeasured. The 512 MiB buffer/file and single 120-second stop-to-finalization budget remain finite; any cap, loss, absent evidence or late completion makes the diagnostic partial.

transportOwnership.pageRelease: After independent CPU saving, final page checkpoint and bounded pending bundle work settle; never waits for browser trace flush/drain.
transportOwnership.browserTraceRelease: After trace completion, EOF, stream close and finalization, or bounded cleanup failure.
transportOwnership.failurePolicy: Unexpected close, failed or late creation/detach, missing required CPU/trace data and cleanup expiry permanently invalidate completeness. Late-created sessions are detached without use; cleanup marks partial before forced detach and never waits beyond its existing total bound.
